question: How many races were held in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year=2023

question: How many drivers are in the archive?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers

question: How many circuits are in the archive?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits

question: What is the earliest and latest season in the archive?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(year),MAX(year) FROM seasons

question: List race names and dates in 2024 in round order.
gold_sql: SELECT name,date FROM races WHERE year=2024 ORDER BY round

question: How many races are recorded in each season from 2020 through 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT year,COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: What are the name and country of the Monaco circuit?
gold_sql: SELECT name,country FROM circuits WHERE circuit_ref='monaco'

question: What is Lewis Hamilton's nationality and date of birth?
gold_sql: SELECT nationality,dob FROM drivers WHERE driver_ref='hamilton'

question: How many race wins does Lewis Hamilton have in the archive?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) WHERE d.driver_ref='hamilton' AND x.position=1

question: How many podium finishes does Max Verstappen have in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE d.driver_ref='max_verstappen' AND r.year=2024 AND x.position BETWEEN 1 AND 3

question: Which driver won the 2024 Monaco Grand Prix? Return the full name.
gold_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND r.name='Monaco Grand Prix' AND x.position=1

question: List the full names of the top 3 finishers at the 2024 British Grand Prix in finishing order.
gold_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND r.name='British Grand Prix' AND x.position BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY x.position

question: What is the total race-points sum for Ferrari in 2024, excluding sprints?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(x.points) FROM results x JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE c.constructor_ref='ferrari' AND r.year=2024

question: Who won the most races for Red Bull in this archive? Return full name and race win count.
gold_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname,COUNT(*) FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE c.constructor_ref='red_bull' AND x.position=1 GROUP BY d.driver_id,d.forename,d.surname ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 drivers by race wins in the archive; return full name and wins, descending.
gold_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname,COUNT(*) FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) WHERE x.position=1 GROUP BY d.driver_id,d.forename,d.surname ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: List constructor names and their race win counts in 2024, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name,COUNT(*) FROM results x JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND x.position=1 GROUP BY c.constructor_id,c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: What were Max Verstappen's points in the final 2024 driver standings?
gold_sql: SELECT s.points FROM driver_standings s JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE d.driver_ref='max_verstappen' AND r.year=2024 ORDER BY r.round DESC LIMIT 1

question: What were McLaren's points in the final 2024 constructor standings?
gold_sql: SELECT s.points FROM constructor_standings s JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE c.constructor_ref='mclaren' AND r.year=2024 ORDER BY r.round DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many qualifying records exist for the 2024 Monaco Grand Prix?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying q JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND r.name='Monaco Grand Prix'

question: What was Charles Leclerc's Q3 time at the 2024 Monaco Grand Prix?
gold_sql: SELECT q.q3 FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE d.driver_ref='leclerc' AND r.year=2024 AND r.name='Monaco Grand Prix'

question: How many pit-stop records are there in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pit_stops p JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2022

question: What was the average recorded pit-stop duration in seconds for the 2024 Monaco Grand Prix?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(p.milliseconds)/1000.0 FROM pit_stops p JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND r.name='Monaco Grand Prix'

question: List the top 5 constructors by shortest average recorded pit-stop duration in seconds in 2022.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name,AVG(p.milliseconds)/1000.0 FROM pit_stops p JOIN results x ON x.race_id=p.race_id AND x.driver_id=p.driver_id JOIN races r ON r.race_id=p.race_id JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=x.constructor_id WHERE r.year=2022 GROUP BY c.constructor_id,c.name ORDER BY AVG(p.milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 5

question: How many lap-time rows are recorded for the 2024 Monaco Grand Prix?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lap_times l JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND r.name='Monaco Grand Prix'

question: What was the minimum recorded lap time in milliseconds for the 2024 Monaco Grand Prix?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(l.milliseconds) FROM lap_times l JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND r.name='Monaco Grand Prix'

question: How many sprint result records are in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sprint_results s JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=2024

question: Which constructors did Fernando Alonso race for in 2023? Return distinct constructor names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE d.driver_ref='alonso' AND r.year=2023

question: Which driver has the best average classification order at Monaco from 2015 through 2024? Return full name and average.
gold_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname,AVG(x.position_order) FROM results x JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN circuits c USING(circuit_id) WHERE c.circuit_ref='monaco' AND r.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY d.driver_id,d.forename,d.surname ORDER BY AVG(x.position_order) ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many pit-stop records exist for 1950?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pit_stops p JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=1950

question: List the names of circuits that hosted a race in 2024 in Italy.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM races r JOIN circuits c USING(circuit_id) WHERE r.year=2024 AND c.country='Italy' ORDER BY c.name
